description: Stops a source from adding new conversations to a dataset. What it already added stays. Get the feedId from caliper_source_feeds_list. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

sourceId.description: Source id, from caliper_sources_list or search_workspace.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: caliper_source_feeds_stop
title: Stop a live dataset
